reviewer.name: Independent source chronology reviewer Jinshu 090 (竇允–王宏–曹攄 tranche)

summary: Partial review of units s0136–s0212 (竇允, 王宏, 曹攄). Supported explicit 永嘉二年/三年 anchors, undated careers/deaths, and retrospective kin; blocked Western interval projections on 泰始/太康/魏/齊王冏/惠帝末 frames. Not chapter approval.

findings.problem: Taishi/Taikang reign phrases in Dou Yun and Wang Hong biographies lack Western interval endpoints in source.
findings.action: Store sourceDate text only or pin each office/edict to annals; do not certify shared AD 265–274 / Taikang spans by default.

findings.problem: Wei-era kinship and office mentions (魏時, 魏侍中粲, 魏衛將軍) lack sentence-level Western bounds.
findings.action: Keep undated Wei attestations; block imported Wei-endpoint intervals until independently sourced.

findings.problem: Eastern Jin turmoil frames (齊王冏輔政, 惠帝末, regency counsel) lack explicit Western years in chapter text.
findings.action: Research each career episode or retain undated attestation; block identical regency interval imports across persons.

findings.problem: Inferred father link for Cao Shu genealogy is marked unresolved in extraction.
findings.action: Do not certify genealogical intermediary without named dated acts in source.
